2315315.text: 2315315 showed up in 2025 and already looks settled at the summit: tempo and bravery both crowd the peak, with aim and headshots a half-step behind them, while lifetime IvI sits in the rarest air of all. Head-to-head results land clearly above the middle rather than leading everything, and resistance trails the rest by a notch. A fast-rising regular with almost no soft spots.

2333ooo.text: 2333OoO wins fights the aim alone would not explain: the matchup rating runs well above average, and tempo, bravery, and resistance run with it, while the lifetime kill-death line reaches the top shelf. The accuracy sits below average, while the lifetime IvI trails in the same lower ground — the shots miss more than most, yet the results keep coming. A regular whose judgment covers what the crosshair does not.

2andrey26.text: 2Andrey26 plays the steady middle of a strong season: comfortably clear of the middle in the matchups, with pace and output running hot too. The head-to-head exchange lands mid-pack, and the lifetime tallies, the aim, and the headshots agree. The edge keeps its share when the fighting stiffens, which keeps the story honest: a strong regular with no single headline.
